title: Modified component Button to show a loading state
context: Every screen of the store uses one shared button, and that button had no way to show that its action is still running. It can now show the text "Loading…" in place of its own text, and it cannot be clicked while it does. No screen asks for that state yet, so every button on every page looks and works as it did.

- **When** a component sets the button to loading, **then** [the button shows "Loading…" in place of its own text](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L30) and [the button is disabled](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L27).
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue, the cart or the account page, **then** nothing changes: no component sets a button to loading.
- **When** a shopper saves the profile form and the save is still pending, **then** nothing changes: the Save button is disabled, as before, and still reads "Save".

- Modified [`<Button />`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#Button) to [take `isLoading`, `disabled` and `children` out of its props](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L16-23), with `isLoading` set to `false` by default.
- Modified `<Button />` to [render `"Loading…"` in place of `children` when `isLoading` is `true`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L30).

children.label: Renders its children, or "Loading…" while it loads
children.description:
Four Entry Points reach this component.

- When a shopper opens any page of the store, [`<RootLayout />` renders this component as "Switch theme"](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L14-16) in the header.
- When a shopper opens the catalogue at /, `<CatalogPage />` renders one `<ProductCard />` per product, `<ProductCard />` renders `<AddToCartButton />`, and [`<AddToCartButton />` renders this component as "Add to cart"](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7).
- When a shopper opens the cart at /cart, `<CartPage />` renders one `<CartLine />` per item and one `<CartSummary />`. [`<CartLine />` renders this component as "Remove"](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L13-15). [`<CartSummary />` renders this component as "Empty the cart"](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L19-21) and [as "Empty it" inside `<Dialog />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L23). [`<Dialog />` renders this component as "Close"](code:src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#L17-19).
- When a shopper opens the account page at /account, `<AccountPage />` renders `<ProfileForm />`, and [`<ProfileForm />` renders this component as "Save" with `disabled={isPending}`](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L24-26).

summary: Modified [`<Button />`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#Button) to [take `isLoading`, `disabled` and `children` out of its props](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L16-23), with `isLoading` set to `false` by default.

waypoints.title: Added `isLoading` to `ButtonProps`
waypoints.reading: The author added a property `isLoading` to the type `ButtonProps`, which is optional and takes a `boolean`. [`<Button />` reads `isLoading` from its props](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L18), so that a component that renders `<Button />` can pass it. No component in the repository passes it.

waypoints.title: Modified `<Button />` to render a loading state
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a component `<Button />` that:

- takes `isLoading`, `disabled` and `children` out of its props, with `isLoading` set to `false` by default
- sets `disabled` on the `<button>` to `disabled || isLoading`
- renders `"Loading…"` in place of `children` when `isLoading` is `true`

A component can now show that its action is still running, which is what the pull request is for. `props` no longer holds `disabled` or `children`, so `{...props}` passes neither to the `<button>`. When `isLoading` is `false`, the `<button>` gets the `disabled` and the `children` of its caller, as before. [`<ProfileForm />` passes `disabled={isPending}` and no `isLoading`](code:src/routes/account/components/ProfileForm.tsx#L24), so its Save button is disabled during a save and still reads "Save".
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the change the pull request exists for: `<Button />` now reads `isLoading` to choose what it renders and whether it is disabled. [`ButtonProps`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#ButtonProps) only declares the property.
